classification_rule: A visible scientific fragment must own an independent scientific question or inferential contract. Scientific-repository identity and evidence-mode membership are separate classifications; programme membership does not imply evidence transfer.

azami.spine: present phenotype -> public evolutionary history -> own-data discrimination

island.spine: WHEN/WHERE -> conditional response WHY -> focal phenotype axes

observation.spine: physical record/diagnosis plus reference refinement -> entry audit -> semantic preservation

interaction.spine: shared-coordinate compromise -> persistent middle world -> differentiated-coordinate architecture

interaction_game_abstraction.spine: static payoff geometry -> population invasion/coexistence/coordination; not Chapter 4

crest_state_theory.spine: future/history/mechanism -> required state -> evidence licensing; meta grammar outside

ecogenetic.spine: mechanistic finite-state parent -> relational state/warning extension

state_measurement_empirical.spine: measurement adequacy -> representation preservation -> residual context -> cross-study identifiability

v3.public_line: 参照情報は、引き算の許可ではなく compatible set を縮める根拠になる。
v3.claim_ceiling: Structural refinement results do not establish that a physical reference is informative or causally attributable in a new domain without calibration and structural assumptions.

payoff.claim_ceiling: Analytic game phases do not establish natural frequency dependence, historical architecture switching, or prevalence without empirical estimation.

balance.owner: middle world where conflict is real but differentiated architecture remains below shared architecture
